power_tags: light that shows what is hidden
themes.quest: I must carry the flame to every grave I pass on a feast day.
themes.description: Vesper found the lantern lit in a condemned chapel, with no oil in it and no wick. It has not gone out since, and the people it shines on tend to tell the truth.

special.name: Feast Day Light
special.description: Once per scene, when you raise the lantern in a place of worship or mourning, you may gain a tier-2 status such as *trusted*, *revered* or *unsettling*.

themes.quest: I must give every drowned voice one last listener.
themes.description: Since the lantern, the dead of the old harbour sing to Vesper. Most of the time it is a comfort. Some nights it is a crowd.

special.name: Chorus
special.description: Once per session, when burning a tag from this theme for Power, you may add 5 Power to the roll instead of 3. After the roll is resolved, you take *haunted-2*.

themes.quest: Nobody dies alone on my shift.
themes.description: Vesper still works three nights a week on the city ambulances. It keeps the rent paid and the voices honest.

special.name: Golden Hour
special.description: Once per scene, when you treat someone within moments of their injury, reduce one of their harm statuses by two tiers instead of one.

themes.quest: Find out how far the drone can really go.
themes.description: Decommissioned by the city, rebuilt in Vesper's kitchen. It answers to a whistle and does not like rain.

special.name: Overwatch
special.description: Once per session, if the drone can take off before a scene, you may gain *eye-in-the-sky-2* or a similar tier-2 status.

tag_combos.label: Light up a liar
